_readme: Slugs whose prompts.ts MUST be in the seven-block scaffold. This list is what gives the lint teeth: strictness is keyed off the component, not off the prompt's own content. If it were keyed off the prompt, an agent facing a red lint could delete the '## 4. Tree' heading and flip the gate green forever. For a slug listed here, a missing heading IS the failure. Add a slug the moment its prompt is converted; forgetting is safe (it stays advisory), removing one is a deliberate change that shows in the diff. Premium slugs belong here on exactly the same terms as free ones: there is no weaker or inverted rule set for premium, so a premium prompt runs the SAME verbatim scaffold plus the orthogonal marker and asset guards in lint-prompts.mjs premiumGuards(). Listing is per slug either way, so a prompt that is not listed here stays advisory, which is why splitPromptAtPaywall() in lib/registry/prompt-blocks.ts fails closed instead of assuming the scaffold is present.
